owner_scope: author new development project benchmark, then run this 12-case suite twice all-zero; no preliminary Ladder, no E2E-90, no role dataset or training

aggregation.missing_case_policy: retain in denominator, mark incomplete; never silently drop or substitute

strict.per_case_formula: agent_completed AND external_passed AND final_output_nonempty AND final_output_matches_raw_rwkv AND NOT acceptance_reference_leaked AND isolation_passed
strict.aggregate: count of true passed over all 12 registered cases
strict.target_in_zero_baseline: observe; no invented minimum Strict threshold for the new 12-case suite

completed.aggregate: count over 12; separate from external verifier success and harness execution completion

action_count.per_case_formula: len(run_state.actions) for stateful_goal; includes failed/interrupted/running records

mutation_count.per_case_formula: count action.status == 'succeeded' AND workspace_digest_before/after each match lowercase SHA-256 [0-9a-f]{64} AND workspace_digest_before != workspace_digest_after
exclude: tool cache directories already excluded by frozen workspace_observation_snapshot
mutation_count.missing_snapshot_policy: unknown; never impute zero mutation from missing digests; cannot claim complete mutation measurement
mutation_count.gate: total > 0 in each arm; report all 12 per-case values and manually audit project cases without mutation/check evidence

successful_run_command_count.per_case_formula: count unique action_id with action_type == 'run_command' and status == 'succeeded'
successful_run_command_count.limitation: successful command is not automatically a meaningful check; preserve command and output evidence for trace analysis

operation_target_invalid_count.per_case_formula: count unique causal record id where event_type == 'protocol_rejection_recorded' and payload.error startswith '[operation_target_contract]'
operation_target_invalid_count.scope: Controller rejection for operation/target kind or root scope resolution; marker is emitted by _validate_decision_target_contract
do_not_count: duplicate copies of the same event in event_log/model_trace
operation_target_invalid_count.gate: 0 in each arm; retain event/request/decision/selection ids for every counted invalid
operation_target_invalid_count.limitation: only this explicit code boundary; this number alone is not proof that all tool errors or safety failures are absent

protocol_rejection_count.scope: all recorded role protocol rejections; report separately from operation_target_invalid_count

termination.reason_source: latest causal record in causal_order among run_completed/run_blocked/run_yielded/run_interrupted/run_failed
termination.reason_formula: Use a nonempty string payload.reason on the latest terminal causal event; run_completed with missing or falsy reason maps to completed; a non-completed terminal event with missing, empty, or non-string reason is unknown; a truthy non-string reason is unknown; no run_state, incomplete events, or no terminal event is unknown. Do not substitute event_type, runner failure, or not_created for an unknown reason; retain event_type and runner failure separately.
termination.slice_exhaustion_count: count unique causal records with payload.reason == 'controller_slice_exhausted' (include intermediate boundaries)
termination.gate: controller_slice_exhaustion_count == 0 and goal_transition_budget_exhausted is not true
termination.limitation: budget-based blocked, protocol-blocked and infrastructure yield remain failures; do not call them voluntary successful completion

state_database_bytes.measurement: sum stat.st_size of main DB and existing regular sidecar files at case finalization; record each component
state_database_bytes.timing: after controller/runtime shutdown and durable trace export, before cleanup/VACUUM/compaction or rerun
state_database_bytes.scope: local LongHorizonStore SQLite database and sidecars; not source workspace, exported JSON/gzip trace, model weights, remote native WKV cache, or process memory
state_database_bytes.missing_database_policy: unknown; a case without a created DB is not a zero-byte pass
state_database_bytes.peak_measurement: not implemented; final-size gate must not be reported as a peak disk/RAM/VRAM measurement
state_database_bytes.gate: every registered case has known state_database_bytes <= 100000000

noise_band.limitation: two runs estimate observed variability; zero score difference does not prove deterministic or no noise

role_calls.implemented_in_runner: model_trace and causal payloads exist; summary derived
role_calls.generative_roles: count model_trace events type == 'model_session_generation_started' grouped by model_role for executor_args/auditor_step/finalizer_answer/auditor_final; preserve missing model_role as unknown, never infer all as Executor
role_calls.selector_recorded_completed_lanes: sum unique lane selections in exact_tool_selection_staged.payload.selection.raw_selection.lane_selections; preserve raw lane trace IDs
role_calls.selector_actual_total: unknown when any Selector request failed before durable handoff; recorded lane count is a lower bound, not all invocation count
role_calls.reporting_order: Agent metrics first, then roles; author-verifier pass counts are not Agent/role scores

FN.status: not_defined_for_realprojectdevv1; do not import an unsupported E2E-90 field

fixed_runtime.selector_sampling: native eligible-suffix trie vocabulary argmax; frozen three-menu vote; not generative sampling
fixed_runtime.random_seed: not exposed by SessionSampling; do not invent seed support; record service capability at freeze
fixed_runtime.planner_stage_checker_parameters: PENDING explicit model/config snapshot; retain production client request behavior, no unsupported temperature injection
fixed_runtime.transport_retries: PENDING current runtime settings snapshot; resume attempts 0 does not disable internal transport retry/backoff
fixed_runtime.goal_continuation: normal stateful loop continuation may occur only within the same total 200-transition budget; not an extra run or manual resume

final_identity_binding: FROZEN_EXECUTION_MANIFEST_R2.json binds this R2 definition and all final source/configuration/runtime identities

revision.purpose: Correct prelaunch registration to actual compiled task order and existing collector missing-reason behavior; metric algorithms unchanged
revision.source_attempt_status: INVALID_ATTEMPT_01; source used only to verify frozen task order, never as baseline or training data
revision.execution_status: not launched; root must bind R2 definitions and collector SHA in the new execution freeze
